This development-only dashboard compares the retained source, extracted text, paraphrased draft, interactive fields, and guided-reflection prompt without publishing drafts.

::: {#resource-paraphrase-review-app .bs-paraphrase-review-app aria-live="polite"}
Loading the local review corpus...
:::

To build this dashboard locally, set `TSK_RESOURCE_REVIEW=1` before rendering. The normal production build omits the draft review data asset.
